game.title: Mackerel Mail
game.tagline: A small cat with a very important postbag delivers letters across three fishing harbours.
game.controls: WASD or arrows move, Space pounces, E meows or delivers, Esc pauses, M toggles sound.

session.notes: Solo, single-session run. All geometry, animation, interface art, effects and music were authored in code for this game. Uses the repository's pinned three.js.
